verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
These things unseen won't cripple me
I place my hope in You

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
This deep desire
This longing hour
I'm falling into You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Love is and always was
The longing place inside my heart
To know You
And be known by You

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
This place
This time
Won't satisfy

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
My soul was made for You
My eyes behold what's beautiful
And I belong to You

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
How I long
How I long
How I long for You
